<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This is a standard AUR PKGBUILD for `leafpad-qtify`, a Qt build of the Leafpad text editor. The `source` array fetches a tarball from the project's own upstream GitHub repository (`github.com/tarot231/leafpad`) pinned to a specific commit (`3b1a2c2a...`), and a real `sha256sums` checksum is provided (not SKIP), so the archive is content-verified.

The `build()` function uses conventional autotools workflow (`intltoolize`, `autoreconf`, `./configure`, `make`), `check()` runs the compiled binary headless, and `package()` performs a normal `make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" install`. There are no network calls beyond fetching upstream source, no obfuscated or encoded commands, no `eval`/`base64`/`curl|bash` patterns, no reverse shells, and no data exfiltration or tampering with unrelated system files. Everything is consistent with ordinary packaging practices.
</details>
